info.title: SMKlog Quote API
info.summary: Live parcel rates from a US origin, a checkout handed to a human, and where that checkout stands.
info.description: Live parcel rates from USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express for a single shipment sent from a US origin: inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated server-side; supply exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. No account and no key. Rate limited per client (about 80 quote requests per hour); quotes cost real money to produce, so cache on your side and do not poll. Buying a label happens on smklog.com — this API prices, it does not sell.

post.summary: Price one parcel from a US origin across USPS, UPS and FedEx (plus DHL Express to Germany and Australia)
post.description: Prices one shipment live against the carriers for the lane. Name the item in plain words and the packed box is estimated server-side (the estimate, its confidence and its assumptions come back in package); send length_cm, width_cm, height_cm, weight_kg and package_source "manual" to price an exact box instead. Up to five purchasable services come back, each a checkout total with the SMKlog fee inside and the carrier counter price beside it. One call per shipment: every call spends a live carrier rating.

x-agentic-access.subject: optional
x-agentic-access.note: Stores a priced payment session and returns a handoff URL; no money moves. The human completes consent and payment on smklog.com, so the agent never needs a subject identity and cannot charge anyone. Every session is recorded with its session_id and is readable through getCheckoutStatus for 30 days.

post.summary: Create or update (upsert) a payment session for one parcel label (MPP intent "session")
post.description: Prices the shipment live, anchors the amount to one service, and returns a handoff URL opening the SMKlog checkout prefilled with the shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This operation never charges: the agent prepares, the human pays. Pass the quote_id from getParcelQuote and the session reuses that quote instead of spending a second carrier call. Create-or-update: send your own external_id (an order or cart id) and the call creates the session if it does not exist for that external_id, or re-prices it in place if it does (same session_id; new amount, service and handoff_url). created in the answer says which branch ran. A session whose checkout the human has already started is not changed: that call answers 409 session_in_checkout with its session_id. Without external_id every call creates a new session. external_id needs a bearer token from /oauth/token and is scoped to that OAuth client, so another client sending the same id reaches a different session; without a token it answers 401 token_required. Retries with the same external_id are idempotent: a timeout or a repeated call never creates a duplicate session. A session lives 30 days from its last create or update; after that the same external_id creates a new one. Optional callback_url: SMKlog POSTs each later stage of the session to it, signed (see the webhooks section), so nothing needs polling. Optional dry_run: price and validate without storing anything. cancelPaymentSession reverses a session the human has not opened yet.

get.summary: Read where a payment session stands
get.description: The stage of the checkout a payment session led to: awaiting_checkout, checkout_started, paid, label_ready (with the tracking number), delivered, refunded, or cancelled (by cancelPaymentSession). Reads SMKlog order records only, no carrier call. Sessions live 30 days; an unknown or expired id answers 404 session_not_found. The answer never carries names, addresses or emails.

x-agentic-access.subject: optional
x-agentic-access.note: Reverses createPaymentSession while the session is still awaiting_checkout: nothing has been paid at that stage, so no human is needed in the loop. From checkout_started on the call is refused with 409 and the human's checkout stands.

delete.summary: Cancel a payment session before the human opens its checkout
delete.description: Reverses createPaymentSession while nothing has happened on the human side. A session in awaiting_checkout is marked cancelled: its handoff link stops binding a checkout to it, its external_id is released for a new session, getCheckoutStatus answers status cancelled with cancelled_at, and a callback_url hears payment_session.cancelled. Window: until the human opens the handoff link. From checkout_started on the call answers 409 session_in_checkout and nothing changes; an unpaid checkout simply expires with the session, and a paid one is refunded by SMKlog support against the order_id getCheckoutStatus reports, never through this API. Idempotent: cancelling a cancelled session answers 200 with the same status. No carrier call and no quote allowance; the status bucket (60 an hour per client) applies.

200.description: The session, now cancelled: status cancelled, cancelled_at set, checkout null. The same answer again when it was already cancelled.

example.next: Cancelled by the agent. The handoff link no longer binds a checkout to this session; create a new session for a new attempt.

post.summary: A payment session reached a new stage (POSTed to your callback_url)
post.description: Sent once per stage a session reaches after it was created with a callback_url: checkout_started, paid, label_ready, delivered, refunded, cancelled. The body is a WebhookEvent whose data is the CheckoutStatus of that moment. X-Smklog-Signature carries t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the session's callback_secret>: recompute it over the raw bytes, compare in constant time, and reject a t older than five minutes. Answer any 2xx within 8 seconds; anything else, a redirect, a timeout or a connection error is retried after 1, 5, 15, 60 minutes, 4 and 12 hours (7 attempts in all), with the same id and X-Smklog-Delivery each time, so deduplicate on id. Redirects are never followed. Order is not guaranteed across retries: read data.status rather than counting events.

parameters.name: X-Smklog-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 over "<t>.<raw body>" with your callback_secret, hex; t is the Unix time of this attempt.

parameters.name: X-Smklog-Event
parameters.description: Same value as event in the body.

parameters.name: X-Smklog-Delivery
parameters.description: Same value as id in the body; constant across retries.

data.next: Label bought. Pass tracking_number to track_parcel for scan events.

2XX.description: Acknowledged: the delivery is marked done and not sent again.

default.description: Any other status, a redirect, a timeout (8 seconds) or a connection error: the delivery is retried on the ladder above, then given up after the seventh attempt.

QuoteRequest.description: One shipment to price. Name the item in plain words (the packed box is estimated) or send the four packed measurements and skip the estimate.

product.description: Plain-words item description, e.g. "Yamaha FG800 acoustic guitar in a hard case". Required unless product_url is given. Drives the box and weight estimate when dimensions are omitted. Text that names no shippable item answers 400 product_not_recognized.

product_url.description: Store product page URL; the item is identified from the page. Alternative to product.

quantity.description: How many of the item ship together. Default 1. Units the estimate packs into one box are priced as that box; units that need more than one box, or a quantity above 1 sent with exact dimensions (those describe one box), return mode multiple_boxes with empty rates.

from_postal_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP; the origin is always in the United States.

to_postal_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP when to_country_code is US or omitted; otherwise the destination country's own postal code.

to_country_code.description: Destination country. Sold online: US, CA, GB, DE, AU; any other answers mode international_unsupported_online with no rates.

length_cm.description: Packed box length. Supply all four of length_cm, width_cm, height_cm, weight_kg to skip the estimate.

weight_kg.description: Packed weight, kg. Online pricing stops at 68 kg (150 lb), 274 cm (108 in) on the longest side and 419 cm (165 in) of length plus girth; beyond that the response is mode not_a_parcel.

package_source.description: Set to "manual" when supplying exact dimensions.

Package.description: The packed box used for pricing: what the estimator (or the caller) said the parcel measures, with the confidence and the assumptions behind an estimate.

description.description: What the box holds, in a few words

confidence.description: How sure the estimate is; manual when the caller supplied the measurements

assumptions.description: What the estimate took for granted, for the human to correct before paying

Rate.description: One purchasable service. Two prices are returned and they are not interchangeable: amount is the checkout total a customer pays, with the SMKlog fee inside it (the fee is itemized only on the checkout receipt), and retail_amount is the carrier’s own counter price for the same parcel where the carrier publishes one (0 where it does not).

service.description: Service display name, e.g. Ground Advantage

service_code.description: Carrier service code, stable across calls

amount.description: Checkout total, USD, SMKlog fee inside

retail_amount.description: Carrier retail counter price, USD; 0 when not published

delivery_days.description: Transit days the carrier quoted, null when it quoted none

delivery_window.description: e.g. "2-5 business days"; null when the carrier quoted none

delivery_estimated_date.description: ISO date the carrier estimates, null when it gives none

QuoteResponse.description: A priced parcel, or a parcel the service will not price with the reason spelled out in mode. Only mode parcel_label_ready carries rates.

mode.description: parcel_label_ready with up to 5 rates; not_a_parcel (empty rates: SMKlog does not arrange pallet or freight shipments); multiple_boxes (empty rates: quote each box on its own); international_unsupported_online; parcel_restricted and review (empty rates with an explanation); parcel_rates_unavailable (no carrier answered).

identified_product_title.description: What the estimator understood the item to be

quote_id.description: Handle to this quote, good for 15 minutes. Pass it to createPaymentSession as quote_id and that call reuses these rates instead of spending a second carrier call. Null when nothing was priced or the handle could not be stored; absent on answers that carry no rates.

packages.description: Every box the estimate produced; one entry when the shipment is one parcel

rates.description: Up to five purchasable services, best value first

dangerous_goods.description: Present when the item matched a dangerous-goods rule: the rule, the carrier restriction and what the human must confirm at checkout

sources.description: Product pages the estimate read, when a search informed it

notice.description: Human-readable reason when mode is not parcel_label_ready

source.description: Where the package estimate and the rates came from

package.description: manual, catalog, or the estimator that produced the box

rates.description: live_carrier for live carrier rating, not_a_parcel when nothing was priced

CheckoutSessionRequest.description: The shipment to open a checkout for: a quote_id from a previous quote, or the shipment itself. Optionally your own external_id, which makes the call a create-or-update.

external_id.description: Your own key for this session, such as an order or cart id. With it the call is a create-or-update: it creates the session if none exists for this external_id, and re-prices that session in place if one does. Needs a bearer token from /oauth/token, because the OAuth client is what scopes the key: without one the call answers 401 token_required. Without external_id every call creates a new session, token or not. Retries are idempotent: the same external_id never creates a duplicate session, it updates the one stored under it, or answers 409 once the human has started its checkout.

quote_id.description: The quote_id a getParcelQuote answer carries (the get_parcel_quote tool returns the same handle), valid 15 minutes. When given, the shipment comes from that quote and product, from_zip, to_zip, to_country and quantity are ignored; an expired handle prices the fields live.

from_zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP. Required unless quote_id is given.

to_zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP, or the destination country's own postal code. Required unless quote_id is given.

quantity.description: How many of the item ship together. Default 1. Units that fit one box get a session for that box; more than one box, or a quantity above 1 sent with exact dimensions, returns no session — one label per box, so create one session per box.

service.description: Optional service to anchor the amount, matched as a case-insensitive fragment of the display name; cheapest when omitted or unmatched.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook. An https URL SMKlog POSTs a WebhookEvent to each time the session reaches a new stage (checkout_started, paid, label_ready, delivered, refunded, cancelled), signed with callback_secret; see the webhooks section. Must name a public host: IP addresses, private names and smklog.com hosts answer 400 invalid_request. On an update by external_id, omit it to keep the stored webhook and send null to remove it. Deliveries are retried up to 7 times over about 18 hours until the endpoint answers 2xx.

callback_secret.description: Optional HMAC key for the X-Smklog-Signature header, 16 to 128 characters. Omit it with a callback_url and SMKlog generates one and returns it once, in callback_secret of this answer; store it, it is never shown again.

dry_run.description: True prices the shipment and validates everything exactly as the real call would, and stores nothing: the answer carries dry_run true, session_id and handoff_url null, and created says which branch the real call would take. A dry run spends a carrier call unless quote_id is given, and draws on the same hourly allowance.

CheckoutSession.description: A payment session, not a charge: the amount and the handoff URL where the human pays. The amount is a live quote at this moment, not a hold or a reservation, and no money moves until the human completes the page.

session_id.description: Handle for getCheckoutStatus, shaped as_ plus a UUID, good for 30 days. Null only when the session record could not be stored.

created.description: Which branch ran: true when this call created the session, false when it updated the session already stored under your external_id. Always true without external_id. Absent only when session_id is null, because then nothing was stored.

external_id.description: The external_id you sent, echoed back; absent when you sent none.

method.description: Payment rails behind the checkout, e.g. stripe, card

amount.description: Live-quoted checkout total for the anchored service, USD

service.description: The service the amount is anchored to

handoff_url.description: Opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment; null on a dry run

dry_run.description: True when the call was a dry run: priced and validated, nothing stored, session_id and handoff_url null.

callback_url.description: The webhook URL stored on the session; absent when none is stored.

callback_secret.description: Present only in the answer that generated it (callback_url sent without callback_secret): the HMAC key the X-Smklog-Signature header is computed with. Shown once.

identified_product_title.description: What the estimator understood the item to be

quote_reused.description: True when the amount came from a quote_id you supplied, so no carrier call was spent

note.description: Standing caveats: live quote, human confirms consents and pays

CheckoutStatus.description: The stage of the checkout a session led to, derived from the order record. Never carries names, addresses or emails.

status.description: Stage, in that order; cancelled when cancelPaymentSession ended the session before the human opened checkout

amount.description: The amount the session was anchored to, USD

service.description: The service the session was anchored to

quote_reused.description: Whether the session reused a quote_id

checkout.description: The checkout the human started, null while awaiting_checkout

order_id.description: SMKlog order id, the reference for support

service.description: The service the human actually chose

estimated_delivery.description: ISO date when the carrier gives one

cancelled_at.description: When cancelPaymentSession cancelled the session; null otherwise

next.description: What, if anything, the agent should do now

WebhookEvent.description: What SMKlog POSTs to a session's callback_url each time the session reaches a new stage. The body carries the current CheckoutStatus under data, so a consumer needs no second call.

id.description: Delivery id, also sent as X-Smklog-Delivery. The same id on every retry of one event, so consumers can deduplicate.

event.description: The stage reached, also sent as X-Smklog-Event

session_id.description: The session the event belongs to

Liveness.description: The liveness answer: the service is up and which version is serving.

version.description: Product version shared by the OpenAPI, the MCP server and the agent card

last_estimate_race.description: Diagnostic: the latest estimator race outcome, null when none is recorded

Problem.description: Every error answer on this host: a stable machine-readable code in error, a sentence for the human in message, and the missing field names when the code is missing_required_fields.

error.description: Stable code: invalid_json, invalid_request, missing_required_fields, product_not_recognized, product_url_not_detected, session_failed, session_in_checkout, session_not_found, rate_limited, invalid_token, token_required

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence

missing.description: Field names still needed, with missing_required_fields and product_not_recognized

session_id.description: With session_in_checkout: the session stored under your external_id, whose checkout the human has started

external_id.description: With session_in_checkout: the external_id you sent

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests this client may make in the current one-hour window of the bucket the operation draws on (IETF draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers).

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window after this one; 0 means the next call answers 429 until RateLimit-Reset elapses.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the window turns and the full allowance returns.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The policy in force as "<limit>;w=<window seconds>": the allowance and the hour it is measured over.

Retry-After.description: On 429 only: seconds to wait before the window turns (RFC 9110 section 10.2.3). Equal to RateLimit-Reset.

clientCredentials.description: Optional. Every operation works without a token. A client that wants its own hourly rate-limit bucket, or the external_id create-or-update on createPaymentSession, holds OAuth 2.0 client_credentials issued by hand (registration instructions at https://smklog.com/auth.md) and sends the opaque bearer it gets from /oauth/token. Discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.
